label: kizuna_home_d_02
text: I have discovered the name of the incredibly\nsweet condiment.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_d_03
text: It is called Sweet Herba Mystica![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_d_04
text: If you should find it during the course of your\nTreasure Hunt, I would be grateful if you would\r\nshare some with me.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_d_05
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)]... Have you
anything
to
report
about
the
Sweet
Herba Mystica?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_d_system_01
text: Give Mr. Saguaro some of your Sweet\nHerba Mystica?

label: kizuna_home_d_system_02
text: You don’t have any Sweet Herba Mystica...

label: kizuna_home_d_06
text: So this...THIS is Sweet Herba Mystica![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_d_07
text: I must—yes!—I must create something with it\nright away![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_d_10
text:
My! What ambrosial sweetness! It is like a sweeter
Honey. A MUCH sweeter Honey.\c
Yes, as if Honey’s sweetness were multiplied
by one hundred![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_d_mob_01
text: Hey, Mr. Saguaro! Whatcha eatin’?

label: kizuna_home_d_mob_02
text: It smells suuuper sweet! And you looked so\nhappy eating it!

label: kizuna_home_d_12
text: N-no! You see, ah...there is a reason for this![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_d_mob_03
text: You don’t LOOK like someone who likes sweets,\nbut that’s pretty cool!

label: kizuna_home_d_13
text: Pretty...cool?![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_d_14
text: I have spent my entire life trying to maintain the\nimage that others have of me.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_d_15
text: But now I see that it is possible to reconcile the\ndifference between my outward appearance and\r\nmy inner love of sweets.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_d_16
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Well then, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)],
here
is
a
reward
for
your
efforts,
as promised.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_d_17
text: Thanks to you, I was able to have a most\ndelectably sweet experience.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_d_18
text: Moreover, I even feel that my narrow-minded\nviews have broadened ever so slightly.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_d_19
text: Please accept my heartiest of thanks.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_d_system_03
text: You formed a close bond with Mr. Saguaro!
